blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to two decimal places using the graphical method, within the specified interval of sign change: \(f(x) = 3x + \sin(x) - e^{x}\), \([0, 1]\).
blocks.explanation:
Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke sawal kis qisam ka hai: yeh graphical method ka sawal hai, aur interval \([0, 1]\) pehle se diya hua hai, yani interval dhoondne ki mehnat nahin karni.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = 3x + \sin(x) - e^{x}\) aur interval \([0, 1]\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan graph \(x\)-axis ko kaatta hai, do decimal places tak.
Rule kaunsa? Location of Root Theorem aur graph; kyun ke is equation mein polynomial, sin aur exponential teeno mile hue hain, algebra se iska koi formula nahin.
Plan: continuity aur sign change check, 0.1 ke qadmon par table, graph, phir 0.01 ke qadmon par zoom, aur aakhir mein LRT se rounding ki tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = 3x + \sin(x) - e^{x}\), interval \([0, 1]\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 1]\) wala root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method (8.2). Equation mein polynomial, trigonometric aur exponential teeno qisam ke terms hain, is liye koi algebraic formula kaam nahin karta; hum graph bana kar crossing parhenge.

Calculator aur continuity
Calculator ko radian mode mein rakhiye.
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(3x + \sin x - e^{x}) \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}\]
Kyun: \(\sin x\) aa raha hai, is liye radians zaroori hain. \(3x\), \(\sin x\) aur \(e^{x}\) teeno har jagah continuous hain, aur continuous functions ka jama aur farq bhi continuous hota hai, is liye \(f\) \([0, 1]\) par continuous hai. LRT lagane ki pehli sharat poori ho gayi.
Dhyan dein: degree mode mein \(\sin 1\) ki value 0.0175 aayegi jo bilkul ghalat hai; sahi value 0.8415 hai.

Diye gaye interval par sign check karein
\[f(0) = 0 + \sin 0 - e^{0} = -1 < 0\]
\[f(1) = 3 + 0.8415 - 2.7183\]
\[= 1.1232 > 0\]
Kyun: dono kinaron par sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq root \(]0, 1[\) mein zaroor hai.
Dhyan dein: \(e^{0} = 1\) hai, zero nahin. Bohat se bachche yahan \(f(0) = 0\) likh dete hain.

Graph banana
Kyun: gyarah (11) points plot kar ke unhein smooth curve se jor dijiye (answer figure dekhiye). Curve \((0, -1)\) se \((1, 1.12)\) tak barhti hai aur \(x\)-axis ko 0.3 aur 0.4 ke beech kaatti hai. Kis ke zyada qareeb? \(f(0.3)\) ki value \(-0.1543\) hai aur \(f(0.4)\) ki \(0.0976\); zero \(0.0976\) ke zyada qareeb hai, magar farq bohat kam hai, is liye zoom karna parega.
Dhyan dein: graph banate waqt \(x\)-axis par 0 se 1 tak poora kaghaz istemal kijiye aur \(y\)-axis par \(-1\) se \(1.2\) tak, taake crossing bari nazar aaye.

0.01 ke qadmon par zoom
\[f(0.34) = -0.0515\]
\[f(0.35) = -0.0262\]
\[f(0.36) = -0.0011\]
\[f(0.37) = 0.0239\]
\[f(0.38) = 0.0486\]
Kyun: sign 0.36 aur 0.37 ke beech badla, aur \(f(0.36) = -0.0011\) taqreeban zero hai, jab ke \(f(0.37) = 0.0239\) us se kaafi door hai. Is liye graph axis ko \(x \approx 0.36\) par milta hai.

Tasdeeq: do decimal places pakke karein
\[f(0.355) = -0.0136 < 0\]
\[f(0.365) = 0.0114 > 0\]
Kyun: LRT ke mutabiq root \(]0.355, 0.365[\) mein hai, aur is interval ka har number round ho kar 0.36 hi banta hai. Is liye 0.36 do decimals tak bilkul sahi hai. Answer key mein bhi 0.36 hai.

answer_figure.caption: Graph of \(y = 3x + \sin x - e^{x}\) on \([0, 1]\); it crosses the x-axis at \(x \approx 0.36\) (original drawing)

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the real roots of the following functions correct to two decimal places using the graphical method, within the specified interval of sign change: \(f(x) = x^{4} - x - 10\), \([1, 2]\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bilkul part (i) jaisa sawal hai: interval \([1, 2]\) diya hua hai, bas function badal gaya hai.
Diya kya hai? \(f(x) = x^4 - x - 10\) aur interval \([1, 2]\).
Find kya karna hai? Graph \(x\)-axis ko kahan kaatta hai, do decimals tak.
Rule kaunsa? LRT aur graph. Quartic (degree 4) ka formula hota to hai magar itna lamba ke koi istemal nahin karta.
Plan: continuity, sign check, 0.1 ke qadmon par table, graph, 0.01 par zoom, aur LRT se rounding ki tasdeeq. Pehle khud try kijiye, phir neeche se milaiye.
Yaad rahe: yahan values bohat tezi se badalti hain (\(-10\) se \(4\) tak), is liye graph ka scale soch samajh kar rakhna hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^4 - x - 10\), interval \([1, 2]\).
Maloom karna: \([1, 2]\) wala root, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: graphical method. Quartic ka formula nazariyati taur par maujood hai, magar bohat lamba hai; graph se parhna kahin zyada aasaan hai.

Continuity
\[f(c) = \lim_{x \to c}(x^4 - x - 10) \quad \forall c \in \mathbb{R}\]
Kyun: \(f\) polynomial hai, aur har polynomial har jagah continuous hota hai, khaas taur par \([1, 2]\) par. Is mein koi trigonometric term nahin, is liye calculator ka mode yahan farq nahin dalta.

Diye gaye interval par sign check karein
\[f(1) = 1 - 1 - 10 = -10 < 0\]
\[f(2) = 16 - 2 - 10 = 4 > 0\]
Kyun: dono ke sign ulte hain, is liye LRT ke mutabiq root \(]1, 2[\) mein hai.

Graph banana
Kyun: points plot kar ke smooth curve banaiye (answer figure dekhiye). Curve \((1, -10)\) se shuru hoti hai, pehle aahista aur phir tezi se upar jati hai, aur \((2, 4)\) tak pahunchti hai. Woh axis ko 1.8 aur 1.9 ke beech kaatti hai, beech se zara aage.
Dhyan dein: y-axis ka scale 2, 4, 6 ... rakhiye, warna graph kaghaz se bahar chala jayega.

0.01 ke qadmon par zoom
\[f(1.84) = -0.3777\]
\[f(1.85) = -0.1365\]
\[f(1.86) = 0.1088\]
\[f(1.87) = 0.3583\]
\[f(1.88) = 0.6120\]
Kyun: sign 1.85 aur 1.86 ke beech badla. \(f(1.86) = 0.1088\) zero ke \(f(1.85) = -0.1365\) se thora zyada qareeb hai, to crossing 1.85 aur 1.86 ke beech wale point se zara aage hai, yani \(x \approx 1.86\).

Tasdeeq: do decimal places pakke karein
\[f(1.855) = -0.0143 < 0\]
\[f(1.865) = 0.2330 > 0\]
Kyun: LRT ke mutabiq root \(]1.855, 1.865[\) mein hai, jo round ho kar 1.86 banta hai. Answer key mein bhi 1.86 hai.
Dhyan dein: \(f(1.86) = 0.109\) bohat chhota nahin lagta, kyun ke yahan curve bohat dhalwan (steep) hai; \(x\) mein zara si tabdeeli se \(f\) bohat badal jata hai. Is liye 1.86 ko radd na kijiye; rounding ka asal saboot yahi sign test hai.
